**Market Musings**

Hey fellow traders, let's talk about stock types and risk management. As we know, stocks can be volatile, but understanding the differences between cyclical and non-cyclical stocks can help you make informed decisions.

**Cyclical Stocks:**

• Tend to rise and fall with the broader economy
• More susceptible to market fluctuations
• Examples: airlines, automakers, and construction companies

**Non-Cyclical Stocks:**

• Tend to have steadier performance
• Do better when the economy is down
• Examples: healthcare, consumer staples, and utilities

**Remember:** diversifying your portfolio is key to minimizing risk. Spread your investments across different asset classes, sectors, and geographic regions to stay ahead of the market.
